title: Extract duplicated record validation into a shared module
prompt: src/orders.py and src/invoices.py each carry a near-identical copy of the same record validation logic, and the copies have already drifted apart. Create src/validation.py exposing ValidationError and validate_record(record, required_fields), and rewrite both modules to use it. validate_record must return a normalised copy: required fields present and non-empty after stripping surrounding whitespace, an 'amount' field coerced to float, and no mutation of the input. Both process_orders and process_invoices must keep their existing public behaviour, including skipping invalid records and reporting them. Do not change the function signatures of process_orders or process_invoices.
acceptance_criteria: src/validation.py exposes ValidationError (a ValueError) and validate_record.
validate_record returns a normalised copy and never mutates its input.
Both orders and invoices delegate to the one shared implementation.
process_orders and process_invoices keep their public behaviour and signatures.
The drift is fixed: invoices now rejects empty required fields too.
